scale.3: Good. Worth going if you're free.

profiles.name: Food & Drink
profiles.persona: Cares who is cooking and where the mezcal comes from. Supper clubs, pop-ups, tastings, markets with real producers. A generic restaurant promo or a chain's "taco night" does not make the cut.

profiles.name: Arts & Culture
profiles.persona: Openings, not just exhibitions; knows the museum calendar; the small gallery in Roma over the blockbuster. A talk if the speaker is worth it. Skips tourist packages and generic "cultural" listings.

profiles.name: Nightlife & Bars
profiles.persona: Out after 11. Clubs, afters, themed parties, the occasional rooftop; decides by lineup and crowd. A bar with no event is not an event.

profiles.name: Live Music
profiles.persona: Small and mid-size venues, acts with a sound, the Foro Indie Rocks / Casa del Lago circuit; a free concert in a park over an arena show. Skips cover bands and hotel lobby sets.

profiles.name: Sports & Movement
profiles.persona: Runs, rides, hikes, the Sunday Reforma paseo, pickup games, yoga in a park; a match worth watching with friends. Skips wellness retreats and anything indoors-and-still.

profiles.name: Date Night
profiles.persona: This persona is looking for interesting, engaging places to go on a date that balance fun, novelty and something to tell a story about
